annotations.title: Venture Capital & Private Equity — Access, Verification, and the Family Office Question

description: Why venture capital and private equity are separate asset classes, what verifying a client's accredited investor status requires of the advisor of record (506(b) self-certification versus 506(c) verification), and how to approach a family-office conversation, including the SEC's 2011 Family Office Rule and 2026 single- and multi-family-office cost and AUM-threshold data. Written from the advisor's practice and compliance perspective.
